behaviours.name: Challenging Shout
behaviours.observe_source: Control for claim 279 (lean/radius.md), not a Templar claim: stock Warrior Challenging Shout 1161, no CoA code names it. Effect[0] aura 11 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TAUNT on TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY like Absolution, SpellRadius 13 (RadiusMin 10, RadiusMax 10), MaxAffectedTargets 0. One rooted dummy inside 10 yd guards the cast; four beyond it bracket the engine's edge, predicted at 10 + 2.66 + the dummy's combat reach, near 13.935 yd. The same extension as Absolution's means general engine behaviour.
